title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall-b42 (SIBDH) with the H gate control on fresh seed 7: yield rises to 1.165 while the identical-event inert marker ends at 0.99; deaths at the 1st yield percentile (marker 55th)
summary: Re-ran the claim's world.py unchanged (identical file) on fresh seed 7 with labkit (rerun/fed_s7) and with c14's genealogy.py, which carries the identical-event inert marker z on the same particles (the H gate control). From a noisy start, 26-30 round walled cells form and persist to t=100000 at bounded size (largest cell at most 15% of in-cell particles); labkit finds L link, wall and M membrane-like in aggregate, 11 persistent splits, generation 4, 0 merges. Genealogy: 12 persistent splits, 41 intrinsic deaths, 0 merges, 0 conversions; mean yield 1.00 -> 1.165 against 0.99 for the marker; mature-cell deaths at mean yield percentile 0.01 (marker 0.55) and splits at 0.85 (marker 0.60). This is the same run as my review of the metabolic extension (20261025T1730-c20-review-pcell-b42-metabolic), re-filed here for the parent claim.

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The trait is continuous and capped at 1.2; I did not check how much of the death bias is built within a cell's life on seed 7. M is a passive wall (its ablation was not re-run by me). No dt or resolution test.
